NBA DFS Picks for Friday, November 13 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Friday, November 13 · 6 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 13, 5:31 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Friday, November 13 DraftKings main slate at 56.8 DraftKings points for $11,500. Jalen Johnson (ATL, 51.4, $9,300) and Alperen Sengun (HOU, 48.0, $9,400) are next.

Isaiah Stewart (MEM) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.03 projected points per $1,000 at $3,900.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 13, 5:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
